run.input: 请调查 inventory-api 在 2026-11-06T08:00:00+08:00 至 2026-11-06T08:15:00+08:00（结束时间不包含）的异常，结合日志与指标，检索并引用支持建议的手册。

output.cause_summary: 在 2026-11-06 08:00–08:15（+08:00）窗口内，inventory-api 出现请求量突增导致的处理能力饱和：request_rate 达 1900 req/s，而 baseline_request_rate 仅 120 req/s（约 15.8 倍），同时 worker_cpu_percent 达 99%、queue_length 达 2400；replica-1 日志报 'Worker queue full: pending=2400; requests rejected with HTTP 503'。日志与指标交叉一致，支持“流量显著超过基线、队列与 CPU 同时饱和、worker 队列满导致请求被拒（503）”的判断。手册 traffic-spike--s01 的识别条件与现场完全吻合。需注意：worker_cpu_percent 高不能单独推断节点算力不足，CPU 配额节流（cpu-throttling--s01）尚未排除；本次未观察到缓存命中率或数据库相关指标异常，cache-miss 手册片段仅作备选，不作为支持证据。
unknowns: 流量突增的来源（上游调用方、重试风暴、爬虫或压测）未证实
是否存在 container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total 上升与 CPU limit 限制，即是否叠加 CPU 配额节流，未查询
窗口内仅返回 1 条 ERROR 日志，WARN/INFO 为空，无法评估影响面（受影响请求数、错误率、延迟分布）
是否与近期发布或配置变更相关（单位请求 CPU 是否变化）未证实
该服务无人工确认的历史故障经验可参考
next_steps: 按 traffic-spike--s01：对比 request_rate 与 baseline_request_rate 的时间曲线，确认突增起点与持续时长，并定位流量来源（按调用方/接口维度拆分）
按 cpu-throttling--s01：查询 container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total 与 CPU limit，判断是否叠加配额节流，避免仅凭 worker_cpu_percent 推断算力不足
按 cpu-throttling--s02：比较发布前后单位请求 CPU 与请求量，区分纯流量增长与代码回归
扩大日志查询范围（含 WARN/INFO 及更长窗口），统计 503 数量与受影响接口，评估影响面
若确认为外部流量突增，评估限流/排队策略与副本扩容；如需变更，由值班人员按变更流程执行，本次未做任何生产修复

tool_catalog.name: search_logs
tool_catalog.description:
Query logs in the current project. Times include timezone; interval is [start, end).

    Returns citeable evidence_id values. Limit is 1-200.

tool_catalog.name: query_metrics
tool_catalog.description:
Query metrics in the current project and [start_time, end_time).

    Leave metric_name unset to inspect available metrics. Returns citeable evidence. Limit is 1-300.

tool_catalog.name: search_runbooks
tool_catalog.description:
Search the current project's troubleshooting handbooks using symptoms and error terms.

    Use observed service/component names and error messages in query. Returns citeable chunk
    evidence_id, source, revision and content. Handbooks guide checks; they are not live telemetry.
    top_k is 1-10. Query is 1-2000 characters. Uses fixed BGE embeddings and pgvector cosine search.

tool_catalog.name: search_experiences
tool_catalog.description:
Find human-confirmed incident experience for a service in the current project.

    Use for related past incidents and applicable investigation steps. Results are historical
    knowledge, not live evidence for a new incident. Returns citeable IDs and original run/time.
    Exact service match, latest confirmations first. Limit is 1-20.

tool_catalog.name: analyze_logs
tool_catalog.description:
Run Python statistics on logs already retrieved in THIS run, using OpenShell only.

    Use only when the user requests statistical analysis. logs is a list of authorized rows.
    Print exactly one JSON value. No network, credentials, package installs or host files.
    Maximum 100 log IDs, code 6000 chars, 8 seconds, 256MiB, output 64KiB.
    Runtime absence is a tool error; never claim analysis succeeded without its result.
